profile.role_note: Healer support; enables both Tune Rupture and Tune Strain teams.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Worth pulling as the top Fusion support; her Off-Tune acceleration and All-DMG buffs grow in value as more Tune Shifting characters release.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Starfield Calibrator (or Discord) + 5-piece Halo of Starry Radiance in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Reactor Husk in the main slot. Aim for a Healing Bonus 4-cost, Energy Regen 3-costs, DEF% 1-costs, and 260% Energy Regen so her Interfered Marker and Critical Protocol fully activate.

ranked_weapons.name: Starfield Calibrator
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. DEF%, Concerto Energy on skill, and team Crit DMG when she heals. Best in slot.

ranked_weapons.name: Discord
ranked_weapons.note: Affordable 4-star; lots of Energy Regen and Concerto Energy. S1 of her signature beats it, but Discord is fine.

ranked_weapons.name: Dauntless Evernight
ranked_weapons.note: ATK and DEF on Intro; solid stat stick.

ranked_weapons.name: Broadblade#41
ranked_weapons.note: ATK buff at high HP; accessible filler.

ranked_weapons.name: Originite: Type I
ranked_weapons.note: Heals on Resonance Skill; budget comfort pick.

echo_sets.name: Halo of Starry Radiance
echo_sets.note: The 3.0 healer set: team ATK buffs scale with Off-Tune Buildup Rate, plus extra healing. Made for her.

echo_sets.name: Rejuvenating Glow
echo_sets.note: Same healing + team ATK buffs, roughly 10% less ATK increase than Halo. Fully viable while farming.

stat_priorities.note: Healing Bonus; her buffing and healing scale off it.
Energy Regen on both 3-costs; 260% total is the target.
DEF% on both; her healing scales with DEF.

teams.name: Premium: Aemeath + Lynae + Mornye

members.name: Aemeath
members.note: Fusion hypercarry; Tune Rupture mode benefits from Mornye's Off-Tune buffs.

members.name: Lynae
members.note: Universal Liberation amplifier with heavy All-DMG buffs; pairs with Mornye's Off-Tune support.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: Heals, boosts Off-Tune Buildup Rate, and amplifies All DMG for both teammates.

teams.rotation: Mornye opens: three Basics, hold Heavy to enter Wide Field Observation Mode, skill into Liberation to deploy High Syntony Field, then Outro to Lynae. Lynae buffs, then Outro into Aemeath's Liberation combo for the big damage window.

teams.name: Alternative: Jingran + Lynae + Mornye

members.name: Jingran
members.note: HP-scaling Fusion heavy-attack carry; Mono Fusion keeps Lupa-style buffs live.

members.name: Lynae
members.note: All-DMG and Liberation amplification for Jingran's burst windows.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: General All-DMG buffs, faster Tune Breaks, and sustain.

teams.rotation: Mornye runs her field-observation opener into Lynae's buff window, then Jingran enters via Intro: Liberation into enhanced Heavy Attack loops, swapping back to Mornye at full Concerto.

tier_badge.label: Meta-defining
tier_badge.note: Top Fusion support; heals, buffs, and accelerates Off-Tune teams.

sources.record: Lynae Best Builds and Teams (Mornye team sections)

sequences.verdict: S0 is already a complete support. Aim S1 — it guarantees the 40% team debuff. S2 adds team Crit DMG; S6 only for whales.

pull_path.why: Full kit: 25% team DMG amp, healing, and debuff potential.
Guarantees the 40% team debuff without a Tune partner — the king dupe.
Up to 32% Crit DMG for the team off her Energy Regen stacking.

nodes.name: The Silent Observer
nodes.effect: Interfered Marker needs no Tune prerequisite and lasts 150% longer; interruption immunity on key attacks.

nodes.name: Morning Star of Entropy
nodes.effect: Team gains up to 32% Crit DMG against Interfered targets (ER scaling); +20% Off-Tune buildup in fields.

nodes.name: Blueprint of Recursion
nodes.effect: Distributed Array restores 25 Concerto Energy and 100 Relative Momentum every 25s.

nodes.name: Latent Variables of the Cosmos
nodes.effect: High Syntony Field healing +30% — sustain only, low DPS impact.

nodes.name: Time Dilation Effect
nodes.effect: Liberation multiplier +40%; Particle Jet multiplier +160% — personal DPS.

nodes.name: To the Far Shores of the Stars
nodes.effect: Liberation deals 400% more DMG; out-of-combat Resonance Energy trickle.

sequences.weapon_vs_dupes: Signature Starfield Calibrator before dupes for most — but S1 wins on raw DPS value.
